description: Puppet bodies: parts on the humanoid skeleton, one line each, with material slots (the palette).

fields.description: What the body is, in plain sentences.
Material slots: each name with its hex colour (the palette).
Parts written for the left side, drawn on both sides.
A limb's radius, for sizes written [k, 'limb'] (my-3d2dge's limbW / 2).
The torso's radius, for sizes written [k, 'torso'] (my-3d2dge's torsoW).
By build id: the limbRadius and torsoRadius it changes.
The material of every part but eyes.
The build it is made for, which the gallery draws it on (engine/dev/galleryScene.ts); '' for any.
How the gallery shows it (engine/core/gallery.ts; x gallery, #gallery/<kind>/<id>): its camera, how long it plays and the states it is shown in.

properties.description: How the gallery frames it: `turntable` (Four views round it, a quarter turn apart, from 25° up, fitted to its size.), `front` (One view from its front left, 25° up, fitted to its size.), or a camera code drawn as written.
How long it plays: four frames, one in each quarter's middle; 0 for a still (a move's or an emitter's: its own length).
The states it is shown in, one frame each (a body's: a sample state, a pose or a stance).
